sections.text:
Ability Power 220. Damages all enemies 2 times with physical time damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
Confuses all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 70.
-Heals all allies for 10% of their max HP every 5 seconds for 40 seconds.
-Removes debuffs from all allies.
-Increases the ATK and MATK of all allies by 30% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases ATK buff limit of all allies by 20% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases MATK buff limit of all allies by 20% for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases ATK and MATK of all allies by 30% for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 4000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 4000
Only [Beloved Patissier] Chocolat can be used as Unlocking Potential material
